summary: Scilex Holding Co filed an 8-K disclosing a binding term sheet with Datavault AI Inc. to purchase 837 Bitcoin for $50 million. An initial $30 million payment is due, with $20 million in quarterly installments through 2028. Consideration may be cash, shares of Scilex common stock, or subsidiary securities, at Scilex's discretion. No definitive agreement has been executed; closing requires regulatory approvals and board finalization. The terms are preliminary and may be terminated, making consummation uncertain. This acquisition of digital assets does not fit standard special-situation categories, thus categorized as Other.
